title: Metabolic Complete Response of Metastatic Oncogene-Negative, PDL1-Negative Nsclc After Chemo-Immunotherapy and Radiotherapy: A Case Report
content: A 71-year-old male ex-smoker presented in October 2021 to our department with a brain and bone metastatic adenocarcinoma oncogene-negative, PDL1-negative NSCLC. He underwent stereotactic radiotherapy for brain metastases, and then chemotherapy with cisplatin and gemcitabine was administered, followed by immunotherapy with Nivolumab. In July 2022, RT to lung tumor and mediastinal nodal was performed with a total dose of 45Gy in 15 fractions. He continued with immunotherapy until December 2022, when a grade 3-4 toxicity from immunotherapy was ob-served (hypothyroidism, psoriasis, cystitis). He achieved a complete clinical response to the therapy. To date, the patient is alive, with a complete metabolic response, without treatment at 35 months from diagnosis.
